name: Короткая и длинная версия
about: Четыре сцены одним планом; длинная склейка берёт все, короткая — первые две. Снимается один раз.

data.title: Сцена 1
data.text:
Realistic live-action cinematic look, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, film grain.

Scene: a quiet seaside pier at dawn; an adult woman, about 30, with long dark hair, in a beige coat, walks toward the camera.

Camera: medium shot, slow push-in.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She walks along the pier toward the camera.
[3s-5s] She stops and looks at the sea.

Audio: waves, seagulls, soft wind.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

data.title: Сцена 2
data.text:
Continue seamlessly from <Picture 1>.

Realistic live-action cinematic look, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, film grain.

Scene continues on the same pier.

Camera: medium close-up, static camera.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She takes a folded letter out of her pocket.
[3s-5s] She reads it, her face softening.

Audio: waves, paper rustling.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

data.title: Сцена 3
data.text:
Continue seamlessly from <Picture 1>.

Realistic live-action cinematic look, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, film grain.

Scene continues on the same pier.

Camera: wide shot, slow pull back.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She smiles and folds the letter.
[3s-5s] She turns and walks away along the pier.

Audio: waves, distant church bells.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

data.title: Сцена 4
data.text:
Continue seamlessly from <Picture 1>.

Realistic live-action cinematic look, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, film grain.

Scene continues on the same pier.

Camera: close-up, static camera.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She crumples the letter in her hand.
[3s-5s] She throws it into the sea and looks away.

Audio: waves, a gust of wind.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

Короткая и длинная версия.

Одни и те же сцены идут в две склейки: длинная — все четыре, короткая — первые две. Сцены снимаются один раз, склеек и выходов два. Порядок и состав склейки — в её панели справа.
